documents.title: Distributed Consensus and Raft Protocol Analysis in Modern Microservices
documents.extracted_text: Distributed consensus algorithms form the bedrock of fault-tolerant replicated systems. The Raft consensus algorithm is designed to be more understandable than Paxos while providing equivalent fault tolerance and performance.
documents.author_name: Prof. A. Vance, Distributed Computing Review (2023)

documents.title: Comparative Study of Asymptotic Complexity in Graph Algorithms
documents.extracted_text: Graph traversal and shortest path computation are fundamental problems in computer science. Dijkstra algorithm computes single-source shortest paths in weighted directed graphs with non-negative edge weights.
documents.author_name: Dr. E. Dijkstra & Dr. R. Tarjan, Journal of Algorithms (2022)
